HOW TO USE THE BLOCKS / XREFS
EACH SHEET IS A BLOCK NAMED AS LISTED; THE SAME NAME IS ALSO A STAND-ALONE DXF FOR XREF ATTACH. INSERT OR XREF AT 0,0, SCALE 1, UNITS mm; PLAN
GEOMETRY IS 1:1 AND THE FRAME IS SCALED BY THE SHEET SCALE.
LAYERS PER THE SPAN TECH STANDARD (SPAN-): SPAN-RB-B1 / B2 / T1 / T2 (BARS), SPAN-RB-UBAR, SPAN-RB-TRIM, SPAN-RB-PUNCH, SPAN-RB-TEXT
(CALL-OUTS), SPAN-RB-MESH, SPAN-RB-TYPE, SPAN-GRID, SPAN-SLAB-EDGE, SPAN-COL, SPAN-BEAM, SPAN-OPENING, SPAN-SUNKEN, SPAN-VOID, SPAN-PT-*,
EXPLODE A BLOCK TO EDIT; RE-RUN THE GENERATOR AFTER THE CONSULTANT REVISES THE G.A. AND RE-ATTACH.
1. PACKAGE GENERATED FROM THE CONSULTANT'S STRUCTURAL DRAWINGS: 2 SLAB LEVEL(S) READ.
3. L01 FIRST FLOOR SLAB PLAN: 19 columns, grid A-B-C-D-E / 1-2-3-4, 2 openings, 2 voids, 0 sunken slabs, 0 beam lines, 1 circular
U-bar regions, 1 PT zones, 0 tendon lines, slab 250 mm.
4. L02 ROOF SLAB PLAN: 20 columns, grid A-B-C-D-E / 1-2-3-4, 2 openings, 1 voids, 0 sunken slabs, 0 beam lines, 2 circular U-bar
regions, 1 PT zones, 0 tendon lines, slab 220 mm.
5. DESIGN DATA READ FROM THE DRAWINGS: topColumns: T16@150 from note "5. TOP BARS OVER COLUMNS: T16@150 B.W. UNLESS NOTED.".
A1. Bottom mesh not specified: T12@200 both ways assumed as bonded reinforcement in PT zones.
A2. Edge U-bars not specified: T12@150 with 1200 mm legs assumed at PT anchorage edges.
A3. Opening trimmers not specified: 2T16 T&B each side + 2T12 diagonals at corners assumed.
A4. Void trimmers not specified: 2T12 T&B each side assumed.
A5. Stock bar length 12 m; laps staggered so that not more than 50 % of bars lap at one section.
